disposition.reason: The Reeds appeal the Weathersfield ZBA's denial of conditional use approval for a commercial firewood processing operation, together with a notice of violation against it; this is a municipal appeal but concerns a nonresidential (industrial) use, not new housing.

evidence.quote: Douglas Reed Sr. and Douglas Reed Jr. (together “Appellants” or “the Reeds”) appeal from a decision of the Town of Weathersfield (“Town”) Zoning Board of Adjustment (“ZBA”).
Appellants submitted the application for conditional use approval for a commercial firewood processing operation run by Mr. Reed Jr.
The ZBA denied their conditional use application and did not overturn the NOV. This appeal followed shortly thereafter.
No residential structure was ever constructed on the property.

judgments.note: Appeal of a ZBA conditional use denial and an NOV for a commercial firewood processing operation, classified by the court as industrial; no housing is proposed (a 2002 mobile home permit on an adjacent parcel was never used and is not at issue).
Appeal from the ZBA's November 5, 2018 decision; the parties stipulated the court may treat the NOV as upheld by the ZBA.
Nonresidential commercial/industrial use; also partly an NOV appeal, which is not new housing.

history.note: Excluded: appeal of conditional use denial and NOV for a commercial firewood processing operation, not housing.
